entities.name: Hapatra
entities.description: A vizier of the Temple of Strength and master of poisons who devoted her life to Rhonas and fights the marauding dead with her basilisk Tuya.

entities.name: Khufu
entities.description: A broad-shouldered, thirty-five-year-old vizier of the Temple of Strength who insists everything is part of the Hour of Glory.

entities.name: Iput
entities.description: The youngest, most fleet-footed vizier of the Temple of Strength, who brings news that Rhonas is dead.

entities.name: Tuya
entities.description: Hapatra's huge basilisk familiar, magically bonded to her, which she rides into battle.

entities.name: Rhonas
entities.description: The God of Strength, killed by the scorpion god, whose death Hapatra and the viziers feel as a pain in the heart.

entities.name: Kefnet
entities.description: The ibis-headed God of Knowledge who tries to repair the Hekma and is killed by the scorpion god.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: The archer god who fights the scorpion god alongside Kefnet and is killed by it.

entities.name: The Scorpion God
entities.description: A giant scorpion-headed god that killed Rhonas and kills Kefnet and Oketra, reforming itself from dust after Oketra beheads it.

entities.name: The Locust God
entities.description: A god atop a spire who sends swarms of locusts to devour the Hekma and mob Kefnet.

entities.name: Bontu
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet whom Hapatra intends to find and keep alive.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet whom Hapatra intends to find and keep alive.

entities.name: Samut
entities.description: A dissenter who joins Hapatra with Djeru to protect Oketra and tells her the gods were manipulated.

entities.name: Djeru
entities.description: A former initiate who joins Hapatra and Samut, wanting to keep the gods alive.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A broad-shouldered planeswalker whom Oketra had claimed as her own and who cries out as she dies; Hapatra tells him to kill the source of the hell.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
aliases: a pale woman in a violet dress
entities.description: A pale woman in a violet dress glimpsed rushing past with Gideon.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The absent God-Pharaoh whom Hapatra blames for the disaster and who is said to be a trespasser from another world.

entities.name: Temple of Strength
entities.description: Rhonas's temple, whose interior is an extensive wildlife preserve training ground called the Holding.

entities.name: The Hekma
entities.description: The barrier protecting Naktamun, eaten away by locusts until a quarter of it vanishes.

entities.name: The Luxa
entities.description: The river whose blood-stained water recedes and leaves an empty riverbed.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: The city of Amonkhet, now overrun by locusts and marauding mummies.

entities.name: Curse of Wandering
entities.description: The curse that animates the dead of Amonkhet, which Hapatra's poisons slow.

entities.name: The Anointed
entities.description: Mummified caretakers who keep performing their duties despite the chaos.

entities.name: Hour of Promise
entities.description: The hour when the Hekma is torn down, said to herald paradise.

events.summary: Hapatra and the other viziers anxiously await word of the new gods on the steps of the Temple of Strength.
events.quote: We should have news of the new gods' intentions by now,

events.summary: All the viziers feel a sudden agonizing pain in their chests as Hapatra sees Kefnet take to the air and locusts gather.
events.quote: A sudden, jarring pain burst in Hapatra's chest

events.summary: Iput returns in tears and announces that the scorpion god killed Rhonas and means to kill them all.
events.quote: The scorpion god killed him. It means to kill them all.

events.summary: Hapatra sees the locust god direct swarms that devour the Hekma and tells the viziers to arm themselves.
events.quote: The locusts were eating away at the Hekma itself.

events.summary: A quarter of the Hekma vanishes and marauding mummies pour into Naktamun while Kefnet tries in vain to repair the barrier.
events.quote: a wave of marauding mummies poured into the city from the wastes beyond.

events.summary: Hapatra arms herself with poisons and summons her basilisk Tuya.
events.quote: The two shared a magical bond

events.summary: Hapatra leads the beasts of the Holding out against the mummies and locusts, cutting down the dead with her poisoned scimitar.
events.quote: With every swipe of her blade, another mummy halted, hunched over, and fell to the earth

events.summary: Hapatra concludes it is the absent God-Pharaoh's fault and saves two children from mummies.
events.quote: The God-Pharaoh who was not here.

events.summary: Hapatra takes Samut and Djeru onto Tuya as they seek to protect Oketra.
events.quote: The two former initiates gracefully climbed atop Tuya

events.summary: Hapatra glimpses Gideon and Liliana running past, and Djeru tells her not to stop.
events.quote: One was Gideon, the broad-shouldered warrior Oketra had claimed as one of her own.

events.summary: Hapatra finds Kefnet and Oketra confronting the scorpion god, and Oketra tells her the gods are there to protect the mortals.
events.quote: We are here to protect you

events.summary: Kefnet and Oketra fight the scorpion god in tandem, and it grazes Kefnet's wing.
events.quote: They moved in tandem with one another

events.summary: Oketra's arrow of white light blasts through the scorpion god's head and it crumbles to dust.
events.quote: The scorpion god's pursuit was halted by Oketra's arrow of white light exploding through his head.

events.summary: The scorpion god reconstitutes itself from dust and stabs Kefnet through the forehead, killing him.
events.quote: the beautiful and brilliant Kefnet, God of Knowledge, was dead before he hit the ground.

events.summary: Oketra leaps between Tuya and the scorpion god and is impaled by its stinger while Gideon cries out.
events.quote: the scorpion god's stinger was lodged in Oketra's gut.

events.summary: Hapatra weeps for her gods, then tells Gideon the source of the hell is his responsibility to kill.
events.quote: Then he is your responsibility to kill.

events.summary: Hapatra resolves to find Bontu and Hazoret and keep them alive at all costs.
events.quote: We must find Bontu and Hazoret and keep them alive at all costs.

relations.quote: its stinger pierced the middle of his forehead.
the scorpion god's stinger was lodged in Oketra's gut.
